title: Chennai Stormwater Drainage, Waterway Network & Topology Provenance

waterways.name: Chennai Basin Drainage Maps (Canals, Rivers, Macro/Micro Drains)
waterways.publisher: Water Resources Dept (WRD) / Chennai Flood SDSS via OpenCity

outfalls.name: Chennai Sewerage & Drainage Collection System (Terminal Chambers & Outfalls)
outfalls.publisher: Chennai Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board (CMWSSB) via OpenCity

methodology.spatial_reference_systems: Storage in EPSG:4326 (WGS84), Metric length and distance calculations in EPSG:32644 (UTM Zone 44N)
methodology.topology_model: Drain Segment -> Junction Node -> Canal/Waterway -> Terminal Outfall
methodology.flow_direction: Surveyed Invert Level Drops (INVERT_SP -> INVERT_EP) and Copernicus GLO-30 DEM gravitational flow.
methodology.non_fabrication: Drain presence is NOT drainage capacity. Blockage percentages, hydraulic capacity, and maintenance scores are strictly marked 'Data Unavailable'.
